reviews.title: Perfect Running Coach app
reviews.text: I am a runner, but haven’t run regularly this year. I have a half marathon in 10 weeks that I need to be somewhat prepared for. I paid I think 40$ for 12 week access. $40 spent on something health for myself- eel. That’s a no-brainer for me. I’m glad I invested in this app.

reviews.title: So far so good
reviews.text: I like the coaching aspect of this app, but it is very easy to miss the cue to start running or increase your speed for the faster intervals.  A 5 or 10 second warning would be helpful to know that your interval is about to begin.  Even better would be a watch app, so that I don’t have to run with my phone in my hand or continuously pulling it out of my pouch.  This app has excellent potential and hopefully with more subscribers, it will be able to tweak the details.

reviews.title: Fraudulent Company
reviews.text: I signed up for an account in April, found out the app didn’t work at all, and canceled my subscription. They reactivated it without permission in June and charged me an additional $34.99. Today, I was charged an additional $89.99. Support has offered me a pathetic “goodwill” offer where they will refund half of the $89.99 charge for a subscription I canceled back in April for an app that does not work.
